title: Volve field Daily Drilling Report DDR-TEST-00021 — wellbore not published in this release

sections.text: P/u and m/u side entry sub assembly, installed cement hose
Performed pre-job meeting to place balanced cement plug
Pumped 10m3 wash pill. Staged up rate to 2200l/min 16bar

Balanced cement plug m 855 m mixed and pumped 8 m3 of 1,95 SG cement slurry, 600 l/min. Zeroed volume counters. Displaced the cement with 9m3. 1000 l/min 12 bar. Caught up with cement, pressure increased to 25bar. Theoretical TOC 755 m MD
Pulled out of cement to 655m at 2 min/stand.
M/u pup w/ pre-installed sponge ball. Circulated above cement plug at 3300 l/min 30 bar, 50 RPM. Diverted returns overboard. Total circulated 75m3 bu)
POOH w/ MST tool from 655m to surface. Average tripping speed of 870 m/hour
Removed ps21 and installed master bushing
Broke off stand#1 and r/b same, l/d MST tool
M/u BOP jetting tool to stand#1. Jet BOP 1400l/min 24 bar 40 RPM. Function tested BOP. L/d BOP jetting tool and r/b DP stand
Performed pre-job meeting to n/d diverter
Drained riser, meanwhile removed BX elevators and rotator. Installed lifting chains for diverter to bails
Pulled master bushing and outer ring, attached lifting chains to diverter. Bled down pressure on diverter, disconnected overshot hose
Pulled diverter and secured same on DP set back area
Disconnected and pull slick joint to rig floor. Meanwhile hook up bleed off line to f-09
Performed pre-job meeting to release BOP tension system
Removed BOP tension cylinders. Meanwhile continued w/ pumping drilling slop batch#6 on f-4. Total preflush pumped of 70m3 batch#6), started pumping drilling slop, batch#6, 1000l/min 140bar
Skidded BOP from well center to test stump. Meanwhile perform maintenance on FWD PRS. Emptied skimmer tank
Dismantled scaffolding from well center. Meanwhile performed maintenance on FWD PRS
Removed master bushing and outer ring in RKB
Performed pre-job meeting to l/d high pressure riser
Connected lifting gear and pulled HP riser, l/d same

Removed split hatches on f-11 and installed solid cover. Meanwhile ventilated gas from annulus on f-09 to rig choke. Meanwhile finished w/ pumping postflush after batch#6 of drilling slop on f-4. Total drilling slop pumped for batch#6 of 123m3, postflush pumped of 140m3 batch#5), 1000l/min 137bar reporting on f-9a
